Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: Watched types per the epic doc; Odoo 20 uses `ir.access` instead of `ir.rule` (compat).
- AC2: Fingerprint = sha256 of the normalised record JSON (sorted keys, volatile fields dropped); same record → same hash.
- AC3: Changes recorded in Ingenium's journal are `by_ingenium: true` and never open events.
- AC4: Events by the system user during a module-upgrade window seen by `version_watch` are suppressed and counted.

| view changed by an Ingenium plan | no open event |
| module upgrade rewrites views | suppressed, counted |
